description: This file defines the SugarFieldUsername class, a custom field class extending SugarFieldBase for handling the display logic of the 'Username' field in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes a method for rendering the detail view of this field using a Smarty template engine.

classes.name: SugarFieldUsername
classes.description: A custom field class extending SugarFieldBase to handle the rendering of the 'Username' field in detailed views.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the field for display in the detail view by setting it up and rendering the appropriate Smarty template.
